3.name: Frenzy
3.description: While raging, enter a Frenzy to make a single melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action on each turn (gain 1 level of Exhaustion when rage ends).

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.description: You can't be Charmed or Frightened while raging; existing Charmed/Frightened effects are suspended during Rage.

10.name: Intimidating Presence
10.description: Use your Action to frighten a creature within 30 ft (WIS save DC 8 + PB + CHA mod).

14.name: Retaliation
14.description: Use your Reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 ft that damages you.

3.name: Spirit Seeker & Totem Spirit
3.description: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals, and choose a Totem Spirit (Bear: Resistance to all damage except Psychic while raging; Eagle; or Wolf).

6.name: Aspect of the Beast
6.description: Gain passive supernatural might from Bear (double carrying capacity, Adv vs push/break), Eagle (1-mile sight), or Wolf (track at fast pace).

10.name: Spirit Walker
10.description: Cast Commune with Nature as a ritual.

14.name: Totemic Attunement
14.description: Gain peak totem magic while raging (Bear imposes Disadvantage on foes, Eagle grants short fly bursts, Wolf knocks Large or smaller targets Prone on hit).

3.name: Ancestral Protectors
3.description: The first creature you hit on your turn while raging has Disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you, and targets have Resistance to its damage.

6.name: Spirit Shield
6.description: Use your Reaction while raging to reduce damage dealt to an ally within 30 ft by 2d6 (3d6 at L10, 4d6 at L14).

10.name: Consult the Spirits
10.description: Cast Augury or Clairvoyance (no slot/components) once per Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Vengeful Ancestors
14.description: When your Spirit Shield reduces damage, the attacker takes Force damage equal to the damage prevented.

3.name: Storm Aura
3.description: Emit a 10-foot Storm Aura (Desert Fire damage, Sea Lightning strike, or Tundra Temporary HP) activated on Rage entry and Bonus Actions.

6.name: Storm Soul
6.description: Gain Resistance to Fire (Desert), Lightning + water breathing (Sea), or Cold + freezing water (Tundra).

10.name: Shielding Storm
10.description: Creatures of your choice inside your Storm Aura gain the Damage Resistance of your Storm Soul.

14.name: Raging Storm
14.description: Reaction triggers punish attackers (Desert Fire retaliation), knock foes Prone (Sea), or freeze targets' speed to 0 (Tundra).

sea_aura.name: Storm Aura (Sea)
sea_aura.hint: Bonus action to strike one creature within 10 ft.

3.name: Divine Fury & Warrior of the Gods
3.description: First weapon hit each turn while raging deals 1d6 + half Barbarian level Radiant or Necrotic damage; spells restoring you to life require no material components.

6.name: Fanatical Focus
6.description: Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw.

10.name: Zealous Presence
10.description: Bonus Action battle cry grants up to 10 allies Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn (1/Long Rest).

14.name: Rage Beyond Death
14.description: While raging, having 0 HP doesn't knock you unconscious; you still make death saves but stay active until Rage ends.

divine_fury.name: Divine Fury
divine_fury.hint: While raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns takes extra damage.

3.name: Form of the Beast
3.description: While raging, manifest natural weapons: Bite (regain PB HP), Claws (extra claw attack), or Tail (+1d8 AC reaction / 10 ft reach).

6.name: Bestial Soul
6.description: Natural weapons count as magical; choose swimming/water-breathing, climbing, or super-leaps recharging after Short or Long Rests.

10.name: Infectious Fury
10.description: Force a hit creature to make a WIS save or attack its ally / take 2d12 Psychic damage (PB/Long Rest).

14.name: Call the Hunt
14.description: Empower allies within 30 ft on Rage entry with +5 Temporary HP each and +1d6 bonus damage once per turn (PB/Long Rest).

3.name: Magic Awareness & Wild Surge
3.description: Detect spells/magic items within 60 ft as an Action; trigger a chaotic Wild Magic table effect whenever entering Rage.

6.name: Bolstering Magic
6.description: Touch a creature to grant +1d3 to attacks/checks for 10 min or restore an expended spell slot of 1st–3rd level (PB/Long Rest).

10.name: Unstable Backlash
10.description: Reaction upon taking damage or failing a save while raging to roll a new Wild Surge effect replacing the current one.

14.name: Controlled Surge
14.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic table and choose which effect occurs.
